Kuki Woman Killed in Manipur, Sparking Gunfire and Restrictions

A Kuki woman was killed in Manipur's Kamjong district amid a drive to demolish illegal bunkers. The incident led to gunfire between Kuki and Naga groups, and subsequent arson. Prohibitory orders were imposed in the area, including near the Chassad police gate junction.
